description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of matches across six categories, labeled 0 through 5. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different number of matches. The slice labeled “0” is light green and represents approximately 13.3% (3910 matches). The slice labeled “1” is a slightly darker green and represents approximately 13.8% (4046 matches). The slice labeled “2” is a pale yellow and represents approximately 22.4% (6583 matches). The slice labeled “3” is a light blue and represents approximately 6.8% (2002 matches). The slice labeled “4” is a medium blue and represents approximately 6.2% (1810 matches). Finally, the slice labeled “5” is a darker blue and represents approximately 10.4% (3043 matches). The chart includes percentage labels displayed inside each slice, as well as the corresponding number of matches in parentheses. Additionally, the total number of matches, 6, and the percentage it represents, 27.2% (8006), are displayed at the top of the chart. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with “0” and progressing to “5”.
